# MiyaraHub Technologies

> MiyaraHub Technologies is an independent studio in Van Alstyne, Texas, making native apps for AV receivers, NAS, UPS, HDMI processors and networks.

## Key facts

- Studio: MiyaraHub Technologies LLC, founded by Meir Miyara, based in Van Alstyne, TX, US.
- What it does: Small, independent software studio building native apps, full-stack web and e-commerce platforms, systems and monitoring tools, device integrations, and DevOps pipelines.
- Platforms the apps are built for: iOS, iPadOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Web.
- Apps on this site: 13; 7 have a live store listing (measured 2026-11-15).
- Developer store pages: <https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/miyarahub-technologies-llc/id1883545892>, <https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=5430508146048197775>.
- Contact: admin@miyarahub.com
- Independence: MiyaraHub Technologies LLC builds independent, third-party applications. Our apps are not created by, affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected with the manufacturers whose hardware they work with.

## Apps

### AVR Maestro family

- [AVR Maestro (for Denon & Marantz AV receivers)](https://miyarahub.com/avr-maestro/): AVR Maestro is an independent app for Denon and Marantz AV receivers on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows. Zones, sound modes, Audyssey, HEOS. Status: released, in [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/avr-maestro/id6762881597), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.miyarahub.avr_maestro&referrer=utm_source%3Dmiyarahub.com%26utm_medium%3Davr-maestro), [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P4M7W4J5106). Rating: 4.96 average from 289 store ratings (October 2026). Dedicated site: <https://avrmaestro.com>.
- [AVR Maestro for Onkyo Pioneer (Integra AV Receiver Remote)](https://miyarahub.com/avr-maestro-onkyo-pioneer/): An independent remote for Onkyo, Pioneer and Integra AV receivers: Dirac Live, AccuEQ, zones and scenes over your local network. Pre-release. Status: not in any store yet; the site marks it "Coming soon".
- [AVR Maestro MC (for Yamaha MusicCast receivers)](https://miyarahub.com/avr-maestro-mc/): AVR Maestro MC is an independent remote app for Yamaha MusicCast AV receivers, in development for iOS, Android, Mac and Windows. Zones, Surround:AI, YPAO. Status: not in any store yet; the site marks it "In development".

### Projector Pilot family

- [Projector Pilot PJLink & VP21 (for Epson projectors)](https://miyarahub.com/projector-pilot/): An independent app for Epson projectors: power, picture, HDR, lens memory and keystone over your network. On iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows. Status: released, in [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/projector-pilot-pjlink-vp21/id6805125447), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.miyarahub.projectorpilot&referrer=utm_source%3Dmiyarahub.com%26utm_medium%3Dprojector-pilot), [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NG7C8T3SB93). Dedicated site: <https://projectorpilot.com>.
- [Projector Pilot D-ILA (for JVC D-ILA projectors)](https://miyarahub.com/projector-pilot-d-ila/): Projector Pilot D-ILA, coming soon: an independent network remote for JVC D-ILA projectors on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows. No account, no cloud. Status: not in any store yet; the site marks it "Coming soon". Dedicated site: <https://projectorpilot.com/jvc/>.

### Other apps

- [Syno Manager (for Synology NAS)](https://miyarahub.com/synology-manager/): Syno Manager is an independent app for Synology NAS on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows. Storage, system health, Docker, cameras and files. $9.99. Status: released, in [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/syno-manager/id6763011668), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.synomanager&referrer=utm_source%3Dmiyarahub.com%26utm_medium%3Dsynology-manager), [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/store/detail/9P19N2B54N1R). Rating: 4.67 average from 9 store ratings (October 2026). Dedicated site: <https://synomanager.com>.
- [UPSight (UPS monitoring over SNMP & NUT)](https://miyarahub.com/upsight/): Monitor your network UPS from iPhone, Android, Mac or Windows. UPSight reads APC, CyberPower and Eaton network cards over SNMP, or NUT. Alerts included. $9.99. Status: released, in [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/upsight-for-cyberpower-eaton/id6762854779), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.miyarahub.upsight&referrer=utm_source%3Dmiyarahub.com%26utm_medium%3Dupsight), [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PCH5VFVQSGH).
- [FuryPath (for HDFury HDMI processors)](https://miyarahub.com/fury-path/): App for HDFury VRRooM, VERTEX2, DIVA, Maestro and more on iPhone, Android, Mac and Windows. Wi-Fi or GO2 Bluetooth. EDID, HDR, Dolby Vision. $9.99. Status: released, in [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/furypath-for-hdfury-devices/id6763290302), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.miyarahub.furypath&referrer=utm_source%3Dmiyarahub.com%26utm_medium%3Dfury-path), [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N1C30TLW0TB).
- [UC Remote (for Unfolded Circle remotes)](https://miyarahub.com/uc-remote/): UC Remote is a free, independent Android app for the Unfolded Circle Remote Two and Remote 3. Activities, entities, now playing and widgets. No ads. Status: released, in [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ucremote.android&referrer=utm_source%3Dmiyarahub.com%26utm_medium%3Duc-remote). Rating: 5.0 average from 40 store ratings (October 2026).
- [Elan Audio Lab](https://miyarahub.com/elan-audio-lab/): Elan Audio Lab is a full-stack e-commerce platform MiyaraHub built for a boutique tube amp brand: catalog, custom amp builder, checkout, iOS and Android. Status: released, in [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/elan-audio-lab/id6760269249), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.elanaudiolab.app&referrer=utm_source%3Dmiyarahub.com%26utm_medium%3Delan-audio-lab).
- [Almanox](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/): Almanox is an offline sun, moon and Milky Way planner for iOS, Android, Mac and Windows: Tonight verdict, golden hour, dark-sky windows and a shot planner. Status: not in any store yet; the site marks it "Coming soon".
- [NexusDeck (for Audyssey calibration files)](https://miyarahub.com/nexus-deck/): NexusDeck manages Audyssey calibration files and uploads .ady curves to Denon and Marantz receivers over Wi-Fi. Pre-release for iOS, Android, Mac and Windows. Status: not in any store yet; the site marks it "Pre-release".
- [Network Deck (for UniFi network controllers)](https://miyarahub.com/network-deck/): Network Deck is an independent app for UniFi controllers: live dashboards, clients, WiFi, VLANs, firewall, multi-site. Coming to iOS, Android, Mac and Windows. Status: not in any store yet; the site marks it "In development".

## Almanox manual

- [The Dark-Sky Finder - Find Certified Dark Skies | Almanox](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/dark-sky-finder/): Where do you drive to escape the light? Almanox ranks the nearest certified International Dark-Sky Places by distance, direction and Bortle class. Offline.
- [Almanox Guide: How to Plan the Night Sky](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/guide/): The complete Almanox guide: read the Tonight verdict, plan the Milky Way core, line up a sun or moon shot, use the 500 rule, and find dark-sky places.
- [Almanox Help & FAQ - Setup, Location, Pro & Troubleshooting](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/help/): Almanox help and FAQ. Getting started, setting your location, what Pro unlocks, the one-time price, offline use, backup and restore, and troubleshooting.
- [Saved Locations - Plan Any Place in Almanox](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/locations/): How Almanox handles locations: use GPS, search a city or type coordinates, save the places you shoot, and every reading recomputes for where you stand.
- [Milky Way Core & Dark-Sky Windows - The Almanox Manual](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/milky-way/): When the Milky Way core rises, how high it peaks, and the exact moonless window to shoot it. Computed on your device, offline, for exactly where you stand.
- [Photo Calculators - 500 Rule, NPF & Hyperfocal | Almanox](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/photo-calculators/): The 500 rule, the stricter NPF rule, and depth of field with hyperfocal distance - computed live for your camera, lens and sensor, on-device in Almanox Pro.
- [Settings, Themes & Alerts - Make Almanox Yours](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/settings/): Set up Almanox: Light, Dark and AMOLED surfaces, accent colours, reorder or hide tabs and cards, back up places and notes, and set sky alerts.
- [The Shot Planner - Sun and Full Moon Alignments | Almanox](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/shot-planner/): Find the day the sun or full moon lines up with your foreground. Pick a body, an azimuth, and a window - Almanox lists each crossing with time and altitude.
- [The Today Tab - Almanox's Sun & Moon Almanac](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/today/): How to read Almanox's Today tab: the sun-path arc, the twilight ladder, day length, the moon card with phase and moonrise/set, for your exact location.
- [The Tonight Verdict - Almanox's 0-100 Night Sky Score](https://miyarahub.com/almanox/tonight-verdict/): How Almanox builds tonight's 0-100 sky score from darkness, moon interference, Milky Way height and cloud, and what Poor, Fair, Good and Excellent mean.

## Company and legal

- [Home Theater, NAS and Network Apps](https://miyarahub.com/): MiyaraHub Technologies is an independent studio in Van Alstyne, Texas, making native apps for AV receivers, NAS, UPS, HDMI processors and networks.
- [App Support and Contact](https://miyarahub.com/support/): Get help with MiyaraHub apps such as AVR Maestro, Syno Manager, UPSight and FuryPath: email and Discord contact, what to include, refunds and common fixes.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://miyarahub.com/accessibility.html): How accessible miyarahub.com is today: our WCAG 2.2 AA aim, what we measured, the known limitations, and how to tell us about a barrier.
- [Legal Notice](https://miyarahub.com/legal-notice.html): Legal notice for miyarahub.com: the company behind the site, its legal form, managing member, location and contact email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://miyarahub.com/privacy.html): What MiyaraHub apps and the Elan Audio Lab store collect, why, who receives it, how long it is kept, your rights, and the details for each app.
- [Terms of Service](https://miyarahub.com/terms.html): The terms for using MiyaraHub apps, the Elan Audio Lab store and this website: license, purchases, device safety, liability and governing law.
